references.text: The original instruction for making the two gold rings on the ephod, as Exodus 39:20 describes their execution.
The description of the ephod and its design, including the shoulder pieces where the rings were to be attached.
The preceding description of how the ephod was made, which provides context for the placement of the rings.
The immediately preceding verse describing the two other gold rings that were made for the breastplate.
Describes how the breastplate was attached to the ephod using the rings mentioned in verse 20.
The original instruction on how the breastplate should be tied to the ephod's rings with a blue cord.
